vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: persona-customer-support
Version: 1.0.5

The skill bundle defines a 'persona-customer-support' agent designed to manage support tickets using Google Workspace tools. The instructions in SKILL.md are consistent with the stated purpose, utilizing standard commands for triaging emails, logging updates to sheets, and scheduling calendar events via the 'gws' utility. No malicious code, data exfiltration, or prompt injection attempts were identified.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only persona that delegates support tasks to a 'gws' CLI and related gws-* utility skills; its declared requirements align with its stated purpose and there is no unexpected request for credentials or installs in this bundle.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (customer support) match the runtime instructions, which call gws commands and workflows for Gmail, Sheets, Chat, and Calendar. Requiring the 'gws' CLI and gws-* utility skills is appropriate for the described tasks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs the agent to run specific gws commands and workflows (triage, convert email-to-task, append to sheets, escalate to chat, insert calendar events). It does not ask the agent to read unrelated files, environment variables, or send data to unexpected endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files; nothing is written to disk by this skill itself. The requirement that the 'gws' binary exist is reasonable for an instruction-only persona.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: This skill declares no credentials itself, which is coherent. However it delegates to gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, and gws-calendar — those utility skills will need OAuth tokens / credentials to access Gmail/Sheets/Chat/Calendar. The user should review and trust those dependent skills before granting access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no install behavior. The skill does not request elevated or persistent privileges and does not modify other skills or system configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This persona itself is just a set of instructions that call the 'gws' CLI and other gws-* skills. Before installing, verify the origin and trustworthiness of the gws binary and each dependent skill (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar) because those will require access to your Gmail, Sheets, Chat, and Calendar data. Check what credentials or OAuth tokens those utility skills request and whether you are comfortable granting that access. Also ensure the 'gws' CLI you have installed is the expected tool from a trusted source.
